source_text.body:
Build a book donation app and demo video in a buildathon
A user used Replit Agent to build the GiveABook app and its demo video within a 24-hour buildathon.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
During the 24-hour Replit 10 buildathon, the user directed Replit Agent to build the GiveABook app that lets people list books, drop them off, and arrange Sunday pickup for nearby readers. The agent also generated the demo video. No further details on prompts, access granted, or human edits are stated.
How it went
The full app launched at the provided Replit link along with its demo video. No metrics or shortfalls are reported.
Worth knowing
Everything was finished inside the single 24-hour buildathon window.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
I have [number] hours to build an app for [cause or event, e.g. a book donation drive]. Build a working version where users can [core action, e.g. list books they want to donate and find a drop-off point], with a simple clean design. When it works, write a 60-second demo script I can record, and pause before deploying publicly.
Original source: https://x.com/AThippesh08/status/2050931383846273333
